title: A Fubini Theorem for Grothendieck Functional Integrals
summary: This paper systematically studies the subset of continuous linear functionals on the projective tensor product of Banach spaces whose norms are bounded by Grothendieck's constant $K_G$. We term such functionals Grothendieck functional integrals. The integral is defined as a linear functional on the projective tensor product space that satisfies the boundedness condition $|μ(x)| \leq K_G \|x\|_π$, where $K_G$ denotes Grothendieck's constant.
